title: Better with Carts
description: a mod that makes crafting more advanced and adds more features for rails and carts
body:
Better with carts is a mod that adds more realistic crafting recipes for rails and carts!

This mod will NOT be upgraded or downgraded to any other version than 1.21.4 nor will it be ported to forge or fabric

this mod adds: better crafting recipes, crossing block, warning and crossing ahead signs, rail item, tie item, wheel item and cart body item.

it is reccomended to play this with the minecart improvements experiment for a better (and faster) experience

signals will not be added, just use redstone or signals from another mod/resource pack/data pack

my youtube: [https://www.youtube.com/@NsLevelCrossings](https://www.youtube.com/@NsLevelCrossings)

planned features: crossing sign, iron pegs, treated wood, ballast.


I do not expect this mod to get popular.
